knowledge:
- key_parameters: compVars=Vector of character strings specifying columns identifying unique compounds (e.g., mass-to-charge ratio, retention time, or compound name) ;; sampleVars=Vector of character strings specifying sample variables present in column names, in the order they appear ;; separator=Character separating each sample variable in the column names ;; colExtraText=Consistent non-identifying text at the beginning of each column name to be ignored ;; missingValue=Value representing missing data in the input (e.g., 1 or 0) ;; cvMax=Maximum coefficient of variation allowed for technical replicates before using the median instead of the mean ;; minPropPresent=Minimum proportion of non-missing values among replicates required to avoid leaving the value empty ;; filterPercent=Proportion of samples in which a compound must be present to be retained (default is 0.8 for the 80% rule) ;; imputeMethod=Imputation method to use ("half-min", "bpca", or "knn") ;; normalizeMethod=Normalization strategy to use ("Median", "ComBat", "Quantile", "Quantile + ComBat", "Median + ComBat", "CRMN", "RUV", "SVA") ;; transform=Transformation method ("log10", "log2", "ln", or "none") ;; covariatesOfInterest=Known covariates (e.g., spike-ins, sex, age) for normalization methods like ComBat, RUV, SVA, or CRMN ;; returnToSE=Logical indicating whether to return a SummarizedExperiment object
- alternatives: pcaMethods package for BPCA imputation ;; VIM package for KNN imputation ;; preprocessCore package for quantile normalization ;; sva package for ComBat batch correction and SVA ;; crmn package for CRMN normalization
- when_to_use: Use when preparing raw or semi-processed mass spectrometry-based metabolomics abundance data (either as a data frame with structured column names or as a SummarizedExperiment object) for downstream statistical analysis.
- pitfalls: Using "knn" imputation with compoundsAsNeighbors = TRUE is significantly slower than using samples as neighbors and can take several minutes or more ;; When using ComBat, a sample variable called "batch" (or specified via the batch parameter) must be present ;; If using a data frame, column names must follow a strict, consistent naming convention where sample variables are separated by a consistent character not present anywhere else in the column name ;; Half-min imputation is fast but may introduce bias

workflows.name: dataframe_pipeline
workflows.intent: Pre-process mass spectrometry metabolomics data stored in a Data Frame format through summarization, filtering, imputation, and normalization.
input: metabolomics_df.csv (Data frame containing compound identification columns and sample abundance columns with structured names)
workflows.stages: 1. Summarize technical replicates using msSummarize() ;; 2. Filter compounds based on presence threshold using msFilter() ;; 3. Impute missing values using msImpute() ;; 4. Transform and normalize data using msNormalize() ;; 5. Alternatively, run the entire pipeline in one step using msPrepare()
workflows.code:
data(msquant)
summarizedDF <- msSummarize(msquant,
                            cvMax = 0.50,
                            minPropPresent = 1/3,
                            compVars = c("mz", "rt"),
                            sampleVars = c("spike", "batch", "replicate", 
                                           "subject_id"),
                            colExtraText = "Neutral_Operator_Dif_Pos_",
                            separator = "_",
                            missingValue = 1)
filteredDF <- msFilter(summarizedDF,
                       filterPercent = 0.8,
                       compVars = c("mz", "rt"),
                       sampleVars = c("spike", "batch", "subject_id"),
                       separator = "_")
imputedDF <- msImpute(filteredDF,
                      imputeMethod = "knn",
                      compVars = c("mz", "rt"),
                      sampleVars = c("spike", "batch", "subject_id"),
                      separator = "_",
                      returnToSE = FALSE,
                      missingValue = 0)
normalizedDF <- msNormalize(imputedDF,
                            normalizeMethod = "quantile + ComBat",
                            transform = "log10",
                            compVars = c("mz", "rt"),
                            sampleVars = c("spike", "batch", "subject_id"),
                            covariatesOfInterest = c("spike"),
                            separator = "_")
preparedDF <- msPrepare(msquant,
                        minPropPresent = 1/3,
                        missingValue = 1,
                        filterPercent = 0.8,
                        imputeMethod = "knn",
                        normalizeMethod = "quantile + ComBat",
                        transform = "log10",
                        covariatesOfInterest = c("spike"),
                        compVars = c("mz", "rt"),
                        sampleVars = c("spike", "batch", "replicate", 
                                       "subject_id"),
                        colExtraText = "Neutral_Operator_Dif_Pos_",
                        separator = "_")

workflows.name: summarized_experiment_pipeline
workflows.intent: Pre-process mass spectrometry metabolomics data stored in a SummarizedExperiment object through summarization, filtering, imputation, and normalization.
input: metabolomics_se.rds (SummarizedExperiment object containing assay abundances, rowData for metabolites, and colData for samples)
workflows.stages: 1. Summarize technical replicates using msSummarize() ;; 2. Filter compounds based on presence threshold using msFilter() ;; 3. Impute missing values using msImpute() ;; 4. Transform and normalize data using msNormalize() ;; 5. Alternatively, run the entire pipeline in one step using msPrepare()
workflows.code:
data(COPD_131)

summarizedSE131 <- msSummarize(COPD_131,
                               cvMax = 0.5,
                               minPropPresent = 1/3,
                               replicate = "replicate",
                               compVars = c("Mass", "Retention.Time", 
                                            "Compound.Name"),
                               sampleVars = c("subject_id", "replicate"),
                               colExtraText = "X",
                               separator = "_",
                               returnToSE = TRUE)
filteredSE131 <- msFilter(summarizedSE131,
                          filterPercent = 0.8)
imputedSE131 <- msImpute(filteredSE131,
                         imputeMethod = "bpca",
                         nPcs = 3,
                         missingValue = 0)
normalizedSe131 <- msNormalize(imputedSE131,
                               normalizeMethod = "median",
                               transform = "none")
preparedSE <- msPrepare(COPD_131,
                        cvMax = 0.5,
                        minPropPresent = 1/3,
                        compVars = c("Mass", "Retention.Time", 
                                     "Compound.Name"),
                        sampleVars = c("subject_id", "replicate"),
                        colExtraText = "X",
                        separator = "_",
                        filterPercent = 0.8,
                        imputeMethod = "bpca",
                        normalizeMethod = "median",
                        transform = "none",
                        nPcs = 3,
                        missingValue = 0,
                        returnToSE = TRUE)
